requirements.description: The user wants the building preferably near green spaces. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.

User requires energy class D or better, so the filter includes classes A1 through D. Area (600 sqm), capacity (45 people), location (Turin) and proximity to green spaces are outside the available columns and are not filtered here.
The user explicitly requires at least 600 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with a >= threshold.

output.explanation: Filters school-type properties (Attività scolastiche) with surface_area >= 600 sqm, within 3.0 km of (45.0677551, 7.6824892), energy class A1 through D, and green score >= 74. Results are ordered by haversine distance from the given coordinates, nearest first. Capacity for 45 people is not a filterable column and was not among the extracted requirements, so it is not applied.
